share.result.image_score.note: Placeholders match; 'corretas' is acceptable feminine agreement.

share.result.text.note: 'corretas' uses feminine plural with no explicit noun; 'correto' (neutral) or adding 'respostas' would be cleaner, but understandable.

shortcuts.lesson_enter.note: German 'dann' (then/afterwards) implies sequence; 'e' suggests simultaneity. 'e depois continuar' is closer.
shortcuts.lesson_enter.suggestion: Verificar a resposta e depois continuar

shuffle.subtitle.note: Correct meaning, placeholders intact, proper diacritics

srs.schedule_days.note: Lowercase 'revisão' at the start of a standalone string should be capitalised for consistency with other entries.

srs.show_only_due.note: 'Só' here is an adverb and should carry an accent: 'só'. Missing accent is a diacritic defect.

statistics.errors.note: 'erros' is lowercase while other labels use sentence/title capitalisation; consistency issue.

subjects.calculus.note: "Cálculo" is the standard PT equivalent for the mathematical field.

subjects.frameworks.note: Loanword retained; standard in PT tech context.

subjects.guitar.note: "Guitarra" in PT-BR typically refers to electric guitar; "Violão" is used for acoustic/classical guitar. Ambiguous without context.

subjects.public_speaking.note: DE 'Rhetorik' maps well to 'Oratória' in a public-speaking context.

subjects.theory.note: DE source is "Musiktheorie" (Music Theory); PT "Teoria" omits "Musical", losing context if shown standalone.

sync.camera_error_hint.note: 'modo colar-o-link' is a literal awkward render of 'Einfüge-Modus' (paste/insert mode); could be cleaner.
sync.camera_error_hint.suggestion: Algo deu errado ao iniciar a câmera. Tente novamente ou use o modo de colagem.

sync.conflicts_intro.note: German says 'pro Eintrag' (for each entry) but PT ends with 'para cada um' (for each one), losing the 'entry' reference.
sync.conflicts_intro.suggestion: Os dois dispositivos alteraram o mesmo registro desde a última sincronização. Escolha qual versão manter para cada registro.

sync.intro.note: The clause 'você clica em' is slightly unnatural; 'clique em' (imperative/instruction tone) better mirrors the source's instruction style.
sync.intro.suggestion: Pareie um celular e um desktop na mesma rede local. A sincronização é sempre opcional; clique em Sincronizar agora quando quiser mesclar mudanças.

sync.no_camera_hint.note: 'opção de colar o link' is a reasonable adaptation; source says 'Einfüge-Modus' (paste mode). Acceptable but slightly paraphrased.

sync.no_user.note: Source uses informal 'du' (2nd person singular); translation switches to formal 'Conclua' (você/3rd person). Tone inconsistency with rest of UI.
sync.no_user.suggestion: Conclua a integração antes de gerar um código de pareamento.

sync.phone_hint_v17.note: Source says 'im Sync-Bereich der Desktop-App'; translation specifies 'Configurações > Sincronização' which adds path not in source, though consistent with scan_hint.

sync.unpair.note: German says simply 'lösen' (unpair/decouple). Adding 'dispositivo' is extra but acceptable; however, it adds unwarranted verbosity vs. source brevity.

sync.unpair_confirm.note: German uses subjunctive nuance 'bis du erneut koppelst' (until you pair again). PT drops 'novamente' at the end — wait, it does include it. However, 'são mantidos' / 'são bloqueadas' use passive present indicative where German uses present tense statements; acceptable but 'ficam mantidos'/'ficam bloqueadas' is more natural. Also missing 'até você parear novamente' should have a comma before 'até'.
sync.unpair_confirm.suggestion: Desparear este dispositivo? Os dados locais são mantidos; as sincronizações futuras serão bloqueadas até você parear novamente.

sync.upload_qr_hint.note: German says 'QR-Code am Desktop' (QR code on the desktop). PT 'QR do desktop' is slightly compressed but understandable. Acceptable.

toast.api_key_restored.note: Wordy relative clause; a more natural PT phrasing would be more concise and idiomatic.

ui.a11y.chart_distribution_label.note: Meaning preserved; word order difference is acceptable in PT.

ui.a11y.chart_radar_value.note: 'Pontuação' (score) diverges from 'Wert' (value). Should be 'Valor' for accuracy.

ui.a11y.chart_timeline_label.note: Accurate rendering of the concept; placeholder preserved.

ui.a11y.chart_timeline_summary.note: 'compreensão em tendência {trend}' is awkward; closer to 'tendência de compreensão {trend}'.

ui.a11y.chart_timeline_trend_up.note: 'ascendente' is a valid translation for 'steigend' in this context.

ui.a11y.streak_cell_label.note: 'em {date}' is slightly unnatural for a specific date; 'a {date}' or 'no dia {date}' is more idiomatic.

ui.a11y.streak_cell_label_zero.note: Same date preposition issue as streak_cell_label; 'em {date}' less idiomatic than 'no dia {date}'.

ui.api_key.required_long.note: 'Configurações' uses Brazilian PT spelling; 'Definições' is European PT. Inconsistent with 'ui.api_key.open_settings' which uses 'definições'.
ui.api_key.required_long.suggestion: Configure uma chave de provedor nas Definições para ativar esta ação.

ui.api_key.skip_banner.note: 'Configurações' is Brazilian PT; 'ui.api_key.open_settings' uses 'definições'. Should be consistent.
ui.api_key.skip_banner.suggestion: Configure uma chave de API nas Definições para usar os recursos de IA.

ui.error_report.category.error.note: German 'Fehler' is singular; pt uses plural 'Erros'. Should be 'Erro'.

ui.error_report.dialog_title.note: 'Comunicar um problema' shifts meaning slightly; 'Reportar erro' or 'Comunicar erro' would be closer to 'Fehler melden'.

ui.error_report.download_json.note: 'Baixar' is Brazilian Portuguese; EU PT uses 'Transferir' or 'Descarregar'.

ui.error_report.intro.note: 'detetou' is missing the correct spelling; EU PT is 'detetou' — actually correct. But 'programador' is fine. Check: ok actually.

ui.error_report.intro_proactive.note: 'die Entwicklung' = development team, singular 'desenvolvedor' is acceptable; meaning preserved

ui.error_report.privacy_note.note: German uses 'jemals' (ever/at any time); PT omits this nuance. Also subject-verb agreement issue: 'Nenhum … são' should be 'são' → needs 'Nunca são enviados' or restructure.
ui.error_report.privacy_note.suggestion: Nenhum conteúdo do projeto, palavra-passe ou chave de API é alguma vez enviado.

ui.errors.unexpected.note: Inconsistent with ui.errors.generic which uses 'correu mal'; 'deu errado' is BR Portuguese, app uses EU PT style.

ui.help.categories.concepts.note: 'Kernkonzepte' → 'Conceitos centrais' is acceptable; 'principais' could also work but this is fine.

ui.help.no_results.note: 'Keine Treffer.' is short/terse ('No results.'); 'Nenhuma entrada correspondente.' is wordier than needed.

ui.help.open_help.note: German source has 'oeffnen' (ascii fallback for 'öffnen'); translation 'Abrir ajuda' is correct.

ui.themes.auto.note: 'Automatico' is missing the accent; correct form is 'Automático'. Also 'sistema' should be capitalised to match source style.

ui.tooltips.chat_language.note: 'que fala' is grammatically valid but slightly informal/clipped; 'que você fala' is more natural and matches the parenthetical style of the source.

ui.tooltips.collapse.note: 'Recolher' is the standard PT term for collapse in UI contexts.

ui.tooltips.delete.note: 'Eliminar' is correct and idiomatic in European PT.

ui.tooltips.download.note: 'Transferir' is the standard European PT term for download.

ui.tooltips.rate_session.note: German is simply 'Sitzung bewerten'; adding 'esta' is a minor expansion not matching the source's brevity.

ui.tooltips.reanalyze.note: 'Reanalisar' is acceptable but 'Executar análise novamente' better mirrors 'erneut ausführen'. Minor stylistic choice.

ui.tooltips.select_all.note: "tudo" is acceptable but "todos" is more idiomatic for selecting all items.

ui.tooltips.settings.note: 'Definições' is the standard European PT term for settings.

ui.tooltips.upload.note: 'Carregar' is correct in European PT for upload.
